title: SDCP 0.1 (Skilleddesk Code Protocol)
description: The single source of truth for the wire format between the SDC app and a host daemon (sdcd). Spec section 5. Three shapes travel: a request envelope, a response, and a one-way notification. Every notification carries exactly one event from the append-only event catalogue (section 5.4); there is no other way for state to reach the UI (section 3.3). Both transports - unix socket / named pipe locally, WebSocket over an SSH tunnel remotely - carry the SAME envelope (section 3.1).

protocolVersion.description: Envelope/SDCP version. Moves only by the migration rules of section 5.7; additive changes keep it.

code.description: Stable, machine-readable. The UI never parses the message (principle P3).

id.description: Caller-chosen correlation id; echoed by the response.

hostId.description: Set when one app multiplexes several hosts over one socket.

notification.description: One-way server push. `seq` is monotonic per daemon run, which is what lets the reducer detect a gap and ask for a replay.

ts.description: RFC 3339, UTC. Supplied by the daemon's clock, never by the UI.

event.description: The append-only event catalogue (section 5.4). `type` is the discriminant; the reducer switches on it and nothing else.

notificationMethods.description: Notification `method` values the daemon may push. The events themselves always travel as `event` notifications.

thumbnail.description: Path under the daemon data dir; null when the turn changed nothing renderable.

methods.description: Per-method params/result schemas, kept terse on purpose: the shapes the UI actually consumes are the events above. `?` marks an optional member.
